headline: Congress named a federal courthouse in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, after judge Sylvia H. Rambo.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. courthouse at 1501 North 6th Street in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, as the Sylvia H. Rambo United States Courthouse. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the courthouse operates or what cases it hears.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on May 10, 2022.
